verdict.rationale: The reasoning docs describe a `reasoning_effort` request parameter for grok-4.7, 4.6 and 4.5 with values `low`/`medium`/`high`/`xhigh`, a documented default of `high`, and runnable examples. The supported effort values also appear on the per-model spec page and in the `capabilities` object returned by GET /v1/models, so they can be discovered programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the effort levels change behavior, and any documented way to turn reasoning off (the docs say it cannot be disabled) or to get confidence signals.
